_comment: Single source of truth for site-level metadata. When forking this template, this is the first file to edit. See FORK.md for the full recipe.

site.title: The DSAI Companion Reader
site.tagline: Read this alongside your first cohort
site.description: A self-paced reader for adults moving into data science and AI: how to learn the craft, how to work with AI tools well, and the shape of the systems your cohort builds will eventually become. Includes a build diary documenting how the site itself was made.

author.name: Swarup Biswas
author.bio: Adult-training instructional designer; teaches DSAI cohorts in Singapore and writes about the craft of learning to build.

navigation._comment: Section slugs in the order they should appear in the site navigation. Must match the folder names under /content/lessons/ (and /content/build-diary if used).

branding._comment: Filled in after the Stitch design step. Until then these are placeholders that the components fall back to.

features._comment: Feature flags. Set to false to hide a feature without removing the code.

seo._comment: Defaults used when a page doesn't override them.
